PREREQ-01_independent_cohort.name: Independent Atypical Speech Confirmation Cohort
PREREQ-01_independent_cohort.observed_evidence: Inventory points exclusively to synthetic mock data (100 rows, 10 synthetic speakers). No real external atypical cohort (e.g., UASpeech) is present. TORGO is repeatedly inspected diagnostic data.
PREREQ-01_independent_cohort.remediation: Acquire or collect external prospective atypical cohort under approved DUA with zero TORGO speaker overlap. Plan established in reports/phase_c/INDEPENDENT_COHORT_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md.

PREREQ-02_research_ethics.name: Institutional Ethics / IRB Approval
PREREQ-02_research_ethics.observed_evidence: No IRB approval documentation, determination letter, or ethical committee identifier exists in repository.
PREREQ-02_research_ethics.remediation: Submit formal pilot study protocol to institutional IRB; receive documented approval prior to subject recruitment. Submission package prepared in reports/phase_c/ETHICS_DUA_AND_CLINICAL_OVERSIGHT_SUBMISSION_PACKAGE.md.

PREREQ-03_data_governance.name: Data Governance, Consent, and DUA
PREREQ-03_data_governance.observed_evidence: No participant consent forms, withdrawal policies, or institutional data use agreements exist in repository.
PREREQ-03_data_governance.remediation: Execute institutional DUA and finalize participant consent procedures including audio de-identification/erasure. Templates prepared in submission package.

PREREQ-04_clinical_oversight.name: Named Clinical and Research Oversight
PREREQ-04_clinical_oversight.observed_evidence: No designated clinical investigator, speech-language pathologist, or emergency physician is named with formal sign-off.
PREREQ-04_clinical_oversight.remediation: Formally designate qualified clinical lead and SLP advisor with non-interventional protocol oversight.

PREREQ-05_frozen_protocol.name: Cryptographically Frozen Evaluation Protocol
PREREQ-05_frozen_protocol.observed_evidence: Review-ready draft protocol prepared but marked DRAFT - NOT APPROVED and not yet cryptographically locked.
PREREQ-05_frozen_protocol.remediation: Obtain clinical and biostatistical sign-offs, lock parameter YAML, compute SHA-256, and preregister on OSF.

PREREQ-06_statistical_plan.name: Justified Statistical Analysis Plan
PREREQ-06_statistical_plan.observed_evidence: Statistical analysis plan prepared with clustered variance handling, Wilson score intervals, and power calculations. Power targets explicitly designated as provisional planning estimates.
PREREQ-06_statistical_plan.remediation: Formal sign-off by credentialed biostatistician prior to data unlocking.

PREREQ-07_threshold_discipline.name: Threshold Provenance and Development-Only Calibration
PREREQ-07_threshold_discipline.observed_evidence: Phase 7.5 served model default tau=0.6000 remains THRESHOLD_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED. Prior Phase 8.2 accidentally reused FER ceiling 0.1500 as decision threshold. No dev-only calibration exists for served model.
PREREQ-07_threshold_discipline.remediation: Calibrate threshold exclusively on a distinct atypical speech development split; preserve uncalibrated disclaimer until completed.

PREREQ-08_participant_safety.name: Participant Safety and Shadow-Mode Constraints
PREREQ-08_participant_safety.observed_evidence: Application operates in strict research demonstration mode on loopback 127.0.0.1. No live dispatch endpoints, 911 connectors, or external alerts exist. Raw audio is not persisted to disk.
PREREQ-08_participant_safety.remediation: Maintain strict isolation and prevent any upstream/downstream operational integration.

PREREQ-09_reproducibility.name: Reproducibility and Offline Runner Infrastructure
PREREQ-09_reproducibility.observed_evidence: Guarded offline runner implemented with strict pre-flight assertions blocking unauthenticated, synthetic, or unmaterialized evaluation. 12 automated unit tests pass.
PREREQ-09_reproducibility.remediation: Keep runner in dry-run mode until all prerequisite approvals exist.

PREREQ-10_access_and_coverage.name: Acoustic and Population Coverage Scoping
PREREQ-10_access_and_coverage.observed_evidence: Current data restricted to 15 English speakers (8 dysarthric, 7 control) recorded in acoustic booth / head-mounted mic. Real-world acoustic coverage and diverse etiologies are unverified.
PREREQ-10_access_and_coverage.remediation: Explicitly restrict claim scope to English dysarthria under controlled acoustic conditions.
